question: Who threw a bomb in the Central Legislative Assembly on 8 April 1929?

options.text: Ram Prasad Bismil and Prafull Das
Chandra Shekhar Azad and Raushan Singh

solution:
The correct answer is __**Batukeshwar Dutt and Bhagat Singh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Batukeshwar Dutt and Bhagat Singh** threw a bomb in the Central Legislative Assembly on 8 April 1929.
 
• This act was a protest against the repressive policies of the British government.
 
• The bomb was thrown into the Assembly as a demonstration of revolutionary opposition and was not intended to cause harm to individuals.
 
• Both Dutt and Singh were arrested immediately after the incident and used the trial as a platform to propagate their revolutionary ideas.
 
• The incident is a significant event in the history of India's struggle for independence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhagat Singh** was a prominent revolutionary freedom fighter who is remembered for his bravery and commitment to the cause of India's independence.
 
• **Batukeshwar Dutt** was also a member of the Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA) and played a crucial role in the revolutionary movement.
 
• Their actions on 8 April 1929 were aimed at awakening the masses to the injustices of British rule and inspiring them to join the freedom struggle.
 
• The Central Legislative Assembly Bombing is a testament to the sacrifices made by revolutionaries in the fight against colonial rule.
 
• The trial following the bombing helped highlight the plight of Indian political prisoners and the oppressive nature of British colonialism.
